10	// OrgPlan is the Tally plan an organization pays for.

12	
13	// Tally's own plans.
14	const (
15		OrgFree     OrgPlan = "free"
16		OrgTeam     OrgPlan = "team"
17		OrgBusiness OrgPlan = "business"

20	// Valid reports whether p is a known plan.

34	// User is a person who can sign in. A user can belong to several organizations.
35	type User struct {
36		ID        string    `json:"id"`
37		Email     string    `json:"email"`
38		Name      string    `json:"name"`
39		CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
40	}
41	
42	// Role is what a member may do in an organization.
43	type Role string
44	
45	// Roles.
46	const (
47		RoleOwner   Role = "owner"
48		RoleAdmin   Role = "admin"
49		RoleBilling Role = "billing"
50		RoleMember  Role = "member"
51		RoleViewer  Role = "viewer"
52	)

57		case RoleOwner, RoleAdmin, RoleBilling, RoleMember, RoleViewer:
58			return true
59		}
60		return false
61	}

64	type Member struct {
65		OrgID     string    `json:"org_id"`
66		UserID    string    `json:"user_id"`
67		Role      Role      `json:"role"`
68		CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
69	}
70	
71	// APIKey lets a member call the API. It acts as that member, with the member's current role.
72	type APIKey struct {
73		ID         string     `json:"id"`
74		OrgID      string     `json:"org_id"`
75		UserID     string     `json:"user_id"`
76		Name       string     `json:"name"`
77		Token      string     `json:"token"`
78		CreatedAt  time.Time  `json:"created_at"`

80		RevokedAt  *time.Time `json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`

84	type Invite struct {
85		ID         string     `json:"id"`
86		OrgID      string     `json:"org_id"`
87		Email      string     `json:"email"`
88		Role       Role       `json:"role"`
89		Token      string     `json:"token"`
90		InvitedBy  string     `json:"invited_by"`
91		CreatedAt  time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
92		AcceptedAt *time.Time `json:"accepted_at,omitempty"`
93		RevokedAt  *time.Time `json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`
94	}
95	
96	// Customer is one of an organization's customers.
97	type Customer struct {
98		ID    string `json:"id"`
99		OrgID string `json:"org_id"`
100		Name  string `json:"name"`
101		Email string `json:"email"`
102		// DefaultPaymentMethod is charged for renewals ("pm_..."); empty means invoices wait to be paid by hand.
103		DefaultPaymentMethod string            `json:"default_payment_method,omitempty"`
104		Metadata             map[string]string `json:"metadata,omitempty"`
105		CreatedAt            time.Time         `json:"created_at"`
106	}
107	
108	// Interval is how often a plan bills.
109	type Interval string
110	
111	// Intervals.
112	const (
113		Monthly Interval = "month"
114		Yearly  Interval = "year"
115	)
116	
117	// UsageType says what a plan charges for.
118	type UsageType string
119	
120	// Usage types.
121	const (
122		// Licensed plans charge UnitAmount per seat (the subscription's quantity) at the start of each period.
123		Licensed UsageType = "licensed"
124		// Metered plans charge UnitAmount per unit of reported usage at the end of each period.
125		Metered UsageType = "metered"
126	)
127	
128	// Plan is something an organization sells to its customers.
129	type Plan struct {
130		ID         string         `json:"id"`
131		OrgID      string         `json:"org_id"`
132		Name       string         `json:"name"`
133		Currency   money.Currency `json:"currency"`
134		UnitAmount int64          `json:"unit_amount"` // minor units
135		Interval   Interval       `json:"interval"`
136		UsageType  UsageType      `json:"usage_type"`
137		TrialDays  int            `json:"trial_days"`
138		Active     bool           `json:"active"`
139		CreatedAt  time.Time      `json:"created_at"`
140	}
141	
142	// SubStatus is a subscription's state.
143	type SubStatus string
144	
145	// Subscription states.
146	const (
147		Trialing SubStatus = "trialing"
148		Active   SubStatus = "active"
149		PastDue  SubStatus = "past_due"
150		Canceled SubStatus = "canceled"
151	)
152	
153	// Subscription is a customer's subscription to a plan.
154	type Subscription struct {
155		ID              string    `json:"id"`
156		OrgID           string    `json:"org_id"`
157		CustomerID      string    `json:"customer_id"`
158		PlanID          string    `json:"plan_id"`
159		Quantity        int       `json:"quantity"`
160		Status          SubStatus `json:"status"`
161		DiscountPercent int       `json:"discount_percent"`
162		// StartedAt is when the subscription began; its billing periods are counted from it.
163		StartedAt          time.Time  `json:"started_at"`
164		CurrentPeriodStart time.Time  `json:"current_period_start"`
165		CurrentPeriodEnd   time.Time  `json:"current_period_end"`
166		TrialEnd           *time.Time `json:"trial_end,omitempty"`
167		CancelAtPeriodEnd  bool       `json:"cancel_at_period_end"`
168		CanceledAt         *time.Time `json:"canceled_at,omitempty"`
169		CreatedAt          time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
170	}
171	
172	// Line is one line of an invoice. A negative UnitAmount is a credit.
173	type Line struct {
174		Description string `json:"description"`
175		Quantity    int64  `json:"quantity"`
176		UnitAmount  int64  `json:"unit_amount"`
177	}
178	
179	// Amount is the line's quantity times its unit amount.
180	func (l Line) Amount() int64 { return l.Quantity * l.UnitAmount }
181	
182	// InvoiceStatus is an invoice's state.
183	type InvoiceStatus string
184	
185	// Invoice states.
186	const (
187		InvoiceOpen InvoiceStatus = "open"
188		InvoicePaid InvoiceStatus = "paid"
189		InvoiceVoid InvoiceStatus = "void"
190	)
191	
192	// Invoice is a bill to a customer.
193	type Invoice struct {
194		ID              string         `json:"id"`
195		OrgID           string         `json:"org_id"`
196		CustomerID      string         `json:"customer_id"`
197		SubscriptionID  string         `json:"subscription_id,omitempty"`
198		Currency        money.Currency `json:"currency"`
199		Lines           []Line         `json:"lines"`
200		DiscountPercent int            `json:"discount_percent"`
201		TaxRateBP       int            `json:"tax_rate_bp"`
202		Status          InvoiceStatus  `json:"status"`
203		PeriodStart     *time.Time     `json:"period_start,omitempty"`
204		PeriodEnd       *time.Time     `json:"period_end,omitempty"`
205		CreatedAt       time.Time      `json:"created_at"`
206		PaidAt          *time.Time     `json:"paid_at,omitempty"`
207		VoidedAt        *time.Time     `json:"voided_at,omitempty"`
208	}
209	
210	// PaymentStatus is a payment attempt's result.
211	type PaymentStatus string
212	
213	// Payment results.
214	const (
215		PaymentSucceeded PaymentStatus = "succeeded"
216		PaymentFailed    PaymentStatus = "failed"
217	)
218	
219	// Payment is one attempt to charge an invoice.
220	type Payment struct {
221		ID          string         `json:"id"`
222		OrgID       string         `json:"org_id"`
223		InvoiceID   string         `json:"invoice_id"`
224		Amount      int64          `json:"amount"`
225		Currency    money.Currency `json:"currency"`
226		Status      PaymentStatus  `json:"status"`
227		FailureCode string         `json:"failure_code,omitempty"`
228		GatewayRef  string         `json:"gateway_ref,omitempty"`
229		CreatedAt   time.Time      `json:"created_at"`
230	}
231	
232	// UsageRecord is usage reported for a subscription to a metered plan.
233	type UsageRecord struct {
234		ID             string    `json:"id"`
235		OrgID          string    `json:"org_id"`
236		SubscriptionID string    `json:"subscription_id"`
237		Quantity       int64     `json:"quantity"`
238		At             time.Time `json:"at"`
239		CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
240	}
241	
242	// WebhookEndpoint is a URL of the organization's that receives events.
243	type WebhookEndpoint struct {
244		ID     string   `json:"id"`
245		OrgID  string   `json:"org_id"`
246		URL    string   `json:"url"`
247		Events []string `json:"events"` // event types, or "*" for all
248		// Secret signs the deliveries (webhooks.Sign).
249		Secret         string    `json:"secret"`
250		Enabled        bool      `json:"enabled"`
251		DisabledReason string    `json:"disabled_reason,omitempty"`
252		CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
253	}
254	
255	// Event is something that happened in an organization, sent to its webhook endpoints.
256	type Event struct {
257		ID        string          `json:"id"`
258		OrgID     string          `json:"org_id"`
259		Type      string          `json:"type"`
260		Data      json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
261		CreatedAt time.Time       `json:"created_at"`
262	}
263	
264	// DeliveryStatus is a webhook delivery's state.
265	type DeliveryStatus string
266	
267	// Delivery states.
268	const (
269		DeliveryPending   DeliveryStatus = "pending"
270		DeliverySucceeded DeliveryStatus = "succeeded"
271		DeliveryFailed    DeliveryStatus = "failed"
272	)
273	
274	// Delivery is the sending of one event to one endpoint.
275	type Delivery struct {
276		ID             string         `json:"id"`
277		OrgID          string         `json:"org_id"`
278		EndpointID     string         `json:"endpoint_id"`
279		EventID        string         `json:"event_id"`
280		Status         DeliveryStatus `json:"status"`
281		Attempts       int            `json:"attempts"`
282		NextAttemptAt  *time.Time     `json:"next_attempt_at,omitempty"`
283		LastAttemptAt  *time.Time     `json:"last_attempt_at,omitempty"`
284		ResponseStatus int            `json:"response_status,omitempty"`
285		Error          string         `json:"error,omitempty"`
286		CreatedAt      time.Time      `json:"created_at"`
287	}
